## PopupBits working rails

These apply in every PopupBits repository. Anything more specific in the rest of
this file, or in `PROJECT.md` where one exists, wins over them.

**Never claim a command passed unless you ran it and saw it pass.** Say plainly
what you could not verify, in as much detail as what you could.

**Gates must be read from a file.** Redirect a test or analyze run to a file and
capture its exit code explicitly. Piping a gate into `tail` or `head` reports
the pipe's status, so a failing run looks green.

**Scripting.** Write tooling and throwaway scripts in Dart.

**Secrets stay out.** Never read, move, or commit keystores, `key.properties`,
`.env*`, service-account JSON, or any signing material, and never paste a secret
into a file, a log, or a commit message.

**Committing and pushing.** Commit only when asked, and commit only the paths
you changed — `git commit -- <path>`, never `git add -A`, which sweeps up work
that is not yours. Do not push unless you are asked to.

**Releases.** Publishing, signing and store submission follow one shared
pipeline across every app. Do not improvise them: use the
`popupbits-release-pipeline` skill, or ask for the release guide.
<!-- popupbits:rails:end -->

## Working on beej

**Read [README.md](README.md) first** — it covers the option matrix, the brick
model and the three registries a generated app extends.

**Gates.** `dart test` is seconds and covers the planner. `dart run
tool/verify_matrix.dart` generates ten configurations and analyzes and tests
each, and is the real safety net: mutually exclusive bricks can never coexist
in one project, so proving the *output* compiles is the only proof there is.
Run it after any template or brick change.

**Templates are embedded.** After editing anything under `templates/`, run
`dart run tool/embed_templates.dart` — a compiled binary reads the generated
`lib/src/render/embedded_templates.g.dart`, not the directory, and a test fails
if the two disagree.

**Agent config a generated app receives** follows the same convention as this
repository: `CLAUDE.md` is exactly `@AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` carries the rails
block and points at `PROJECT.md`, and `PROJECT.md` is the long guide.
